crosswalk.note: Expert data, RL environments and continual-learning infra are the deployment→invention channel; lab recoupment ⇄ capex-to-revenue.

definition: Whether a public benchmark scores retention and improvement across sessions, the ladder's L6 test (Appendix E).
name: A benchmark for learning on the job
unpublished_reason: A yes/no, not a series: Epoch's CL-bench rows score learning from material supplied within one task (domain reasoning, rule application, procedure, empirical discovery), not retention across sessions, so they do not meet the L6 six-month-employee test.
why_it_matters: Without a benchmark the top rung cannot be observed, so the ladder tops out by construction.
